# Bridge UI (monorepo)

> Source repository for `@bridge-ui/core`, `@bridge-ui/react`, and `@bridge-ui/vue`.

## Packages

- packages/react — React components (+ transitive `@bridge-ui/core`)
- packages/vue — Vue components (+ transitive `@bridge-ui/core`)
- packages/core — types, tokens, utils

## Docs (per package)

- packages/react/docs/components/
- packages/react/docs/examples/
- packages/vue/docs/components/
- packages/vue/docs/examples/
- docs/README.md — monorepo index
- docs/RELEASE.md — release guide

## AI resources (per package)

- packages/react/ai/
- packages/vue/ai/

Consumer install:

```bash
npx bridge-ui-react-ai install
npx bridge-ui-vue-ai install
```

## Monorepo agent entry

- AGENTS.md
